- We are in PT but the team is distributed; Emilia (cc'd) will own coordination on our side.

One request: can we move the meeting to Oct 6, 16:00 PT instead of the afternoon slot you proposed? Our CPO has a conflict earlier. Also we have one compliance-related question about data routing and VPC/private deployment options — would be great if Vivek can join for that piece.
